text: some members from the family of the [[Tubba'|تُبَّع]] that remained. Of course, they didn't have any political power anymore, but there were still some members of the family that remained.
And one of the members of the family, he was from the descendants of [[Tibban As'ad|تبان أسعد]], his name was [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]].

And [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]] was able to penetrate through the kingdom, or through the palace, with a weapon concealed under his clothes. He was able to come into the kingdom, or come into the palace of [[Lakhni'ah|لخنيعة]] with a weapon.
And he was actually able to stab [[Lakhni'ah|لخنيعة]] with this dagger. So once he killed [[Lakhni'ah|لخنيعة]], then [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]]...
...took back the kingdom of [[Yemen|اليَمَن]] again. So the the rule returned to the family of the [[Tubba'|تُبَّع]].

So the the rule was with the family of the [[Tubba'|تُبَّع]] for so many years and so many generations, and then for a few years it was taken away, and [[Lakhni'ah|لخنيعة]] and his gang took over. But then after some time, [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]], who was from the family of the [[Tubba'|تُبَّع]], he was able to kill [[Lakhni'ah|لخنيعة]] and get the rule of [[Yemen|اليَمَن]] back to his family.
So the rule of [[Yemen|اليَمَن]] returned to the family of the [[Tubba'|تُبَّع]]. And [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]] was the new king. [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]] was the new king.
All right. Now during the rule of [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]], there was an incident that happened in [[Najran|نَجْرَان]].

There was an incident that happened in [[Najran|نَجْرَان]]. And [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] is in present-day Saudi Arabia, it's in the southern part of present-day Saudi Arabia, and it's close to the border of [[Yemen|اليَمَن]]. It's a city close to the border of [[Yemen|اليَمَن]].

And what's important about this city and the people of this city is that during the time of the Prophet ﷺ while he was in [[Madinah|مدينة]], a delegation of Christians came from [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] to meet with the Prophet ﷺ in [[Madinah|مدينة]].

And this story is recounted in the [[tafsir|تَفْسِير]] of Surah [[Ali 'Imran|آل عِمْرَان]]. The delegation of Christians that came from [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] to speak with the Prophet ﷺ in [[Madinah|مدينة]].
So [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] was a city that had Christians. And how did Christianity initially enter into the Arabian Peninsula, and particularly into the city of [[Najran|نَجْرَان]]?

This is important to know, because when we go on with the [[Seerah|سِيرَة]] of the Prophet ﷺ and his time in [[Madinah|مدينة]], and we talk about his meeting with this Christian delegation from [[Najran|نَجْرَان]], we need to know why were there Christians in [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] in the first place.
So the story of how the Christians came into [[Najran|نَجْرَان]], it happened during the time that [[Dhu Nuwas|ذو نواس]] was ruling [[Yemen|اليَمَن]].

There was a man, a Christian, and he was actually a Unitarian Christian. He was a Christian who really believed in the true message of [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]]. He didn't worship [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]], and he didn't consider [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]] to be the son of Allah, rather he was a true Christian on the real [[deen|دِين]] of [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]].
And they were known as the [[Muwahhidin|مُوَحِّدِين]], meaning the Christians who believed in [[tawhid|تَوْحِيد]], they didn't believe in the Trinity.

So there was a man, his name was [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]], and he was a Christian from [[Sham|شَام]], meaning from the greater Syria area, and he was on the religion of [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]]. He was on the religion of [[tawhid|تَوْحِيد]].

And he used to travel to do [[dawah|دَعْوَة]], he used to go to different places to call people to [[tawhid|تَوْحِيد]]. So he was on a trip from [[Sham|شَام]], from greater Syria, he went to Africa. He went to Africa to do [[dawah|دَعْوَة]], to call the people to [[tawhid|تَوْحِيد]].
And while he was in Africa, he was captured by a gang. And in those days, you know, there were gangs that used to capture foreigners and then they used to sell them into slavery.

So while [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] was in Africa, he was captured by one of these gangs and he was sold into slavery, and the buyer was a man from [[Najran|نَجْرَان]]. The buyer was a man from [[Najran|نَجْرَان]].

So [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] was captured and he became a slave of this man, and the man, he took him back with him to [[Najran|نَجْرَان]]. So [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] came from greater Syria, he went to Africa to do [[dawah|دَعْوَة]], he was captured, sold into slavery, and now he's headed to [[Najran|نَجْرَان]].

This is the first Christian who entered into the Arabian Peninsula. So now [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] is in [[Najran|نَجْرَان]], and he's a slave. And he accepts that, okay, he's a slave, this was the [[qadar|قَدَر]] of Allah for him, this is what Allah had destined for him.

He was a very pious man, he was a devoted worshipper, and he accepted whatever Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] had written for him. So he was a slave for this man, and he served him as a slave. But whenever he had free time, in the nights and other times that he wasn't working, he would devote himself to [[ibadah|عِبَادَة]].

He would worship Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] whenever he had any free time. And he was such a devoted and pious worshipper of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], and Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] actually granted him some miracles.

There are some people from the pious worshippers of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] shows miracles through them, He gives them some miracles, and [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] was one of these people. So one day in the night, he was worshipping Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], he was doing his [[ibadah|عِبَادَة]], and his owner, he comes in the room and he sees that [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] is busy in worship and there is light around him.

And he doesn't know where this light is coming from, there are no candles, or there's no fire or nothing, but there's light all around him while he's worshipping. So when [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] finished his prayer, his owner asked him, "What is this? This is something amazing, something I have never seen before."
So then [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] saw this as an opportunity to give him [[dawah|دَعْوَة]], to give his owner [[dawah|دَعْوَة]].

So he said, "You know, I am a believer in the message of [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]], [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]] was the messenger of Allah, this is what he taught us, to worship Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] alone without any associate, without any partner. He told us not to worship any creation, not to worship any idols." He explained to him what [[tawhid|تَوْحِيد]] was, and what was the message of [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]].

So after explaining this, the owner, he was hesitant, because it wasn't easy for him to admit that the religion that he was following was wrong. So he was hesitant to accept the religion of [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]], his slave, even though he saw with his own eyes this miracle, he saw the light around him while he was doing his [[ibadah|عِبَادَة]].

And during that time, the people of [[Najran|نَجْرَان]], they had a tree that they used to worship and they considered this tree to be their god, the object of their worship. So they used to worship this tree.
So [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]], when he saw the hesitance of his owner from accepting the doctrine of [[tawhid|تَوْحِيد]] and the message of [[Isa|عِيسَى]] [[alayhis-salam|عَلَيْهِ السَّلَام]]...

...he said to him, "Okay, I see that you're hesitant, but let me ask you a question: what do you think if my God destroys your god, meaning that tree, the tree that they used to worship? If my God destroys your god, then will you worship my God?"

And then he said, "In that case, of course. If your God destroys my god, then I will know that, if this tree gets destroyed, then I will know that will be proof that it's not actually a god. So of course, if your God destroys this tree, then definitely I will believe in the message that you are teaching me and I will worship your God."

So [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] said, "Okay, I don't want to do this just in front of you. I want you to gather all of the people of [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] by the tree that you worship, and then I want them all to witness what happens."
He said, "Okay." So he called the people and they all gathered near that tree that they used to worship, and [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] also came.

And he started making [[du'a|دُعَاء]] to Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], sincere [[du'a|دُعَاء]] to Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]], "Ya Allah, guide these people, show them this sign that they are asking for, so that they will know that what they are worshipping is false and is not worthy of worship, and that they will accept You and they will worship You alone." He started making [[du'a|دُعَاء]] and he continued to make it with sincerity and with perseverance.

And then the answer of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] came. Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] sent down a bolt of lightning, it hit that tree, and the tree burst into flames. The tree was destroyed, and the whole city of [[Najran|نَجْرَان]] who used to worship that tree, they witnessed this in front of their own eyes.

So when they saw that, they said, "[[Amanna bi-Rabb il-'alamin|آمَنَّا بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ]]." They said, "We believe in the Lord of the worlds, we believe in Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]]," and they accepted the religion of [[Faymiyun|فَيْمِيُون]] and they became Christians.
So this is how Christianity entered the Arabian Peninsula, and in particular...
